question: Use iClusterPlus to integrate RNA-seq, DNA variant, and copy number data for unsupervised clustering and to identify three molecular subtypes. Visualize the identified molecular subtypes using PCA.

expected_output.guidelines: Cluster assignments must match the reference partition at the record level, with at least 80% of samples agreeing after optimal label remapping; cluster label values and column order may differ.
Points colored by cluster membership; axis labels, color scheme, and point styling may differ.
